{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for completed orders
completed_orders = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']

# Count the number of completed orders
n_completed = len(completed_orders)

# Compute the mean revenue of completed orders
mean_revenue = completed_orders['revenue_clean'].mean()

n_completed, mean_revenue"}
